steps.hardClue: Survive an underground lockdown, then repair four damaged ventilation units.
steps.clue: Survive the Generators lockdown, then repair the four Nova-6 ventilation units.

steps.hardClue: Get a melee kill by the television, set five clocks and enter the final time into the computer.
steps.clue: Get a Galvaknuckles kill by the television, set five clocks and enter the final time into Rushmore.

steps.hardClue: Guide the glowing crawler into the medical facility.
steps.clue: Guide the red Nova-6 Crawler into the Transfusion Facility.

steps.hardClue: Enter four hidden codes into the computer, then activate the robot.
steps.clue: Enter the four activation codes into Rushmore, then activate Sergeant A.D.A.M. in Storage.

steps.hardClue: Lead the robot to the hidden intruder and collect the canister he throws out.
steps.clue: Lead Sergeant A.D.A.M. to Marlton’s door and collect the Element 115 canister.

steps.hardClue: Have an electrical enemy open the server, then deliver its core before it overheats.
steps.clue: Use a Jolting Jack to open the Power House server, then use the Telepads to deliver its core.

steps.hardClue: Have zombies knock down three paintings, then enter the revealed codes into the computer.
steps.clue: Use Brain Rot zombies to knock down three paintings, then enter the revealed codes into Rushmore.

steps.hardClue: Set six underground switches correctly, then restore the main power.
steps.clue: Set the six bunker power switches correctly, then restore power at the Power House.

steps.hardClue: Complete three mannequin lockdowns, then repair the unit in the interrogation room.
steps.clue: Complete three A.D.A.M. mannequin lockdowns, then repair the unit in APD Interrogation.

steps.hardClue: Escort the floating orb into the repaired unit.
steps.clue: Escort the Elemental Orb into the repaired A.D.A.M. Unit.

steps.hardClue: Fill one soul canister to release the enemy, then charge four backup canisters.
steps.clue: Fill the APD soul canister to release Avogadro, then charge the four backup soul canisters.

steps.hardClue: Force the boss back into the containment device, then recover the shard.
steps.clue: Force the Avogadro back into the APD, send him to TranZit, then recover the Elemental Shard.
